translations.web: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
translations.bsb: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.
translations.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
